verses.1: As people began to grow in number across the earth, daughters were born to them.
verses.2: The sons of God saw that the daughters of men were beautiful, and they chose wives from among them.
verses.3: Then the LORD said, "My Spirit will not remain with people forever, because they are only flesh. They will live no more than 120 years."
verses.4: In those days, and even afterward, there were people on the earth called the Nephilim. They were born when the sons of God had children with the daughters of men. These became the great and famous warriors of long ago.
verses.5: The LORD looked at the earth and saw that people had become very wicked. Every thought in their hearts was evil all the time.
verses.6: The LORD was sorry that He had made people on the earth, and it broke His heart.
verses.7: The LORD said, "I will wipe out the people I created from the face of the earth — people, animals, crawling things, and birds — because I am sorry I made them."
verses.8: But Noah was different. He found favor in the eyes of the LORD.
verses.9: This is the story of Noah's family. Noah was a good and honest man who stood apart from everyone else in his time. Noah walked with God.
verses.10: Noah had three sons: Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
verses.11: The earth had become very sinful in God's sight and was full of violence.
verses.12: God looked at the earth and saw how bad it had gotten. Every person on earth had turned away from the right path.
verses.13: God said to Noah, "I have decided to put an end to all people, because the earth is full of their violence. I am going to destroy them along with the earth.
verses.14: Build an ark out of gopher wood. Make rooms inside it and cover it inside and out with tar to make it waterproof.
verses.15: Here is how you are to build it: it should be 300 cubits long, 50 cubits wide, and 30 cubits tall.
verses.16: Put a roof on it and leave an opening near the top. Put a door in the side of the ark. Build it with three levels — a lower, middle, and upper deck.
verses.17: I am going to send a great flood on the earth to destroy every living thing that breathes under the sky. Everything on earth will die.
verses.18: But I will make a special promise with you. You will go into the ark — you, your sons, your wife, and your sons' wives.
verses.19: Bring two of every kind of living creature into the ark with you to keep them alive. There must be a male and a female of each kind.
verses.20: Bring two of every kind of bird, every kind of animal, and every kind of creature that crawls on the ground — a male and a female of each — so they will survive.
verses.21: Also gather every kind of food that can be eaten and store it up. It will be food for you and for all the animals."
verses.22: Noah did everything exactly as God told him to do.

metadata.source: Based on the Authorized King James Version (1769), reinterpreted through the theology of abiding in Christ.
